tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Hong Kong horse racing meeting at Sha Tin or Happy Valley: every race with post time, class, distance, course, status, the AI top pick and, after the race, the first three. Without a date it returns the next upcoming meeting (or the latest one if none is scheduled).

tools.name: get_race
tools.description: One Hong Kong race: full field with draw, jockey, trainer, weight, rating, latest win odds, the AI model's win probability and rank for every runner; after the race also finishing positions, margins and HKJC dividends.

tools.name: get_tips
tools.description: AI top four for every race at a Hong Kong meeting, ranked by the model's win probability, with how the AI top pick was settled once the race is run. Without a date: the next upcoming meeting.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: The public, pre-race-sealed record of every AI top pick ($10 win + $10 place at HKJC dividends), compared with backing the favourite in the same races. Losses included.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Hong Kong racehorses, jockeys and trainers by Chinese name, English name or brand number (e.g. H464). Returns ids usable with get_horse / get_person.

tools.name: get_horse
tools.description: A Hong Kong racehorse: trainer, rating, age, pedigree, career record, the last 10 runs (class, distance, draw, jockey, finishing position, odds, AI rank) and a written form summary. Accepts a Chinese or English name, brand number or id.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: Season statistics for a Hong Kong jockey or trainer: rides, wins/seconds/thirds, rank, win rate, most frequent partners and recent rides. Accepts a Chinese or English name or id.

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: This season's Hong Kong jockey or trainer championship table: rank, rides, 1st/2nd/3rd, win rate and the last 30 days.

tools.name: get_partnership
tools.description: How a Hong Kong jockey and trainer have done together over the last two seasons: rides, wins, placings and recent rides together.

tools.name: get_draw_stats
tools.description: Win and place rates by draw for a Hong Kong course: venue, distance and rail position (A, A+3, B, B+2, C, C+3, or AWT for Sha Tin all-weather).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_meeting · Private data: get_track_record, get_horse · Public sink: get_meeting · Destructive: get_tips.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_meeting · Private data: get_track_record, get_horse · Public sink: get_meeting · Destructive: get_tips

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
